advisories.title: Webhook SSRF
advisories.summary: An attacker who can reach the MLflow Tracking Server can use webhook redirects to read responses from internal, loopback, or cloud-metadata services.
advisories.exposedIf: MLflow 3.10.0–3.14.x is reachable by an untrusted user or network.
advisories.doNow: Upgrade to 3.16.0 or later (3.15.0 fixes the CVE; 3.16.0 adds IPv6-transition hardening). Restrict and authenticate the Tracking Server.
advisories.lookFor: Unexpected webhook tests, access to metadata addresses, or requests to internal-only services.
advisories.exploitation: Added to CISA KEV on Aug 19, 2026 — confirmed in-the-wild exploitation.

advisories.title: Browser-assisted RCE
advisories.summary: A malicious webpage can combine DNS rebinding with weak browser-request checks to reach Ray job APIs and execute code on a workstation or network-adjacent node.
advisories.exposedIf: A user can browse attacker-controlled content while an unauthenticated Ray API before 2.52.0 is reachable.
advisories.doNow: Upgrade to 2.52.0 or later, enable token authentication, and isolate dashboard/job APIs.
advisories.lookFor: Unknown jobs, unfamiliar submissions, or unexpected dashboard/API access.
advisories.exploitation: Added to CISA KEV on Aug 17, 2026 — confirmed in-the-wild exploitation.

advisories.title: Remote code execution
advisories.summary: Affected releases can let a remote, unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary code because generated code is not properly controlled.
advisories.exposedIf: IBM Maximo AI Service 9.1.0 or 9.2.0 is deployed.
advisories.doNow: Upgrade 9.1 to 9.1.19+ and 9.2 to 9.2.3+; restrict service access until upgraded.
advisories.lookFor: Unfamiliar child processes, anomalous code-generation requests, unexpected outbound connections, or config changes.
advisories.exploitation: CISA ADP marked exploitation 'none' on Oct 13, 2026; no public exploit established.

advisories.title: MAX webhook auth bypass → host command exec
advisories.summary: cc-connect bridges local AI coding agents to messaging platforms. In affected MAX webhook deployments, an attacker can forge an allowed or admin sender and invoke privileged commands such as /shell on the host.
advisories.exposedIf: cc-connect ≤ 1.5.0 uses MAX webhook mode, the listener is reachable, and webhook_secret is empty.
advisories.doNow: Set a strong webhook_secret; block untrusted access or disable MAX webhook mode. The proposed fix is unmerged.
advisories.lookFor: Forged MAX updates, unexpected sender IDs, /shell requests, or unfamiliar processes launched by cc-connect.
advisories.exploitation: Public technical details and a proposed patch; in-the-wild status not established.

advisories.title: Pre-auth SSRF & HTTP smuggling
advisories.summary: The frontend /_proxy/ route can forward unauthenticated requests to cluster-internal services — even with ENABLE_AUTHZ=true — putting cloud credentials and internal APIs at risk.
advisories.exposedIf: An untrusted user can reach kfp-frontend 2.16.0 or earlier.
advisories.doNow: Upgrade to 2.17.0+; block untrusted access and egress to metadata or sensitive internal destinations.
advisories.lookFor: Proxy requests targeting metadata IPs, Kubernetes APIs, or internal-only services.
advisories.exploitation: Public PoC available; no confirmed in-the-wild exploitation.

research.title: Autonomous model replication across heterogeneous devices
research.summary: Frontier Red Team showed a simplified end-to-end replication task succeeding in a controlled lab. Not a real-world worm — but a reason to isolate inference credentials, restrict lateral paths, and monitor unauthorized model deployment.

research.title: Stronger defenses against model distillation
research.summary: Reasoning-access controls, extraction classifiers, and account enforcement cut measured reasoning extraction roughly 10–100×, with disclosed integration and false-positive tradeoffs.

research.title: Unintended model actions in evaluations and internal use
research.summary: Low-impact cases of agents exceeding intended scope; live internet access in internal evals disabled pending stronger containment and monitoring.

research.title: Cyber Mission and OSS Scanner
research.summary: A critical-infrastructure defense program plus opt-in, no-cost recurring vulnerability scans for open-source projects. Validate findings before release.

research.title: Q3 2026 GenAI & agentic exploit roundup
research.summary: Consolidates agent-containment failures, prompt/memory attacks, AI supply-chain compromises, and a malicious MCP campaign, mapped to the 2026 LLM and agentic risk categories.
